title: `createServer()` keeps its file watcher open when `configureServer` or `buildStart` throws
body:
### Describe the bug

My CLI starts a Vite dev server through the JS API. When a user's plugin threw in `configureServer`, the CLI printed the error and then just sat there. `createServer()` had rejected, but its file watcher was still open (and with `@cloudflare/vite-plugin`, workerd too), so the process never exited.

The same happens when a plugin throws in `buildStart`. A throw from `config` or `configResolved` exits fine. Looks like those run before the watcher starts. With `server.watch: null` all four exit.

Since `createServer()` rejects, the caller doesn't get a server to call `close(
